posts.headline: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump Tariffs, Markets Rally
posts.body: The Supreme Court struck down President Trump's sweeping tariffs, sending stocks rallying. The S&P 500 gained 0.7% and the Nasdaq snapped a 5-week losing streak. Investors celebrated the ruling as a major win for markets.

posts.headline: Tech Stocks Surge on Tariff Ruling
posts.body: Tech stocks led the rally after the Supreme Court blocked Trump's tariffs. Nvidia and other megacaps rallied hard as trade uncertainty diminished. The volatility index dropped significantly on the news.

posts.headline: Tesla Rallies on Market Volatility Decrease
posts.body: Tesla shares rallied along with the broader market as tariff concerns faded. The electric vehicle maker benefited from reduced macro uncertainty. Options activity shifted to calls as bullish sentiment returned.

posts.headline: Economic Growth Misses Expectations
posts.body: Despite the market rally, economic growth data disappointed. GDP came in below expectations, creating a mixed sentiment. Investors weigh continued growth concerns against tariff relief.

posts.headline: Prediction Markets Flash Correction Warning
posts.body: Prediction markets are flashing a stock market correction warning for 2026. Historical data suggests the S&P 500 could drop further ahead of midterm elections. Traders remain cautious despite Friday's rally.
